landing.title: Crisis Impact Reporter
landing.subtitle: Real-time reports.
landing.staffLogin: Crisis Operations Centre — Authorised Personnel Only
landing.slide1Desc: An open-source, real-time platform that empowers community members to report damage, infrastructure failures, and humanitarian needs directly from the field — even in low-connectivity environments.
landing.slide2Desc: Tap Report a Crisis, allow location access, take or upload up to 4 photos of the damage, select the infrastructure type, and submit. Our AI will auto-classify the damage grade.
landing.slide3Desc: No internet? No problem. Reports are saved locally on your device and automatically synced to the server once your connection is restored. Your report will never be lost.
landing.slide4Desc: After submitting, you receive a unique reference number. Use it to track your report through four stages: Submitted, Under Review, Responded, and Resolved.
landing.slide5Desc: Community reports helped coordinate emergency response within hours of flooding.
landing.slide6Desc: Real-time reporting enabled rapid assessment of structural damage across affected zones.
landing.slide7Desc: Road damage reports allow responders to reroute aid convoys immediately.
cocLogin.restrictedDesc: This portal is for authorised UNDP staff only. Unauthorised access is strictly prohibited.
